يبتنيا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَنِيَا (yabtaniyā) /jab.ta.ni.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# يُبْتَنَيَا (yubtanayā) /jub.ta.na.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
